key: Oh, it's you again!
en: Oh, it's you again!
ja: あら、またあなたね!

key: I finally caught up to Snubbull, but it still isn't behaving.
en: I finally caught up to Snubbull, but it still isn't behaving.
ja: ようやくブルーを捕まえたんだけど、まだ言うことを聞いてくれなくて。

key: I know it would listen if I only had a Gym Badge, but I know there's no way I could get one.
en: I know it would listen if I only had a Gym Badge, but I know there's no way I could get one.
ja: ジムバッジさえあれば言うこと聞くって分かってるんだけど、手に入れられるわけがないし。

key: I'm just not sure what to do.
en: I'm just not sure what to do.
ja: どうしたらいいか分からないの。

key: I finally caught up to Stufful, but it still isn't behaving.
en: I finally caught up to Stufful, but it still isn't behaving.
ja: ようやくヌイコグマを捕まえたんだけど、まだ言うことを聞いてくれなくて。

key: Wait a second, you have Badges?
en: Wait a second, you have Badges?
ja: ちょっと待って、バッジ持ってるの?

key: I didn't realize that you were such a skilled Trainer.
en: I didn't realize that you were such a skilled Trainer.
ja: あなたがそんなに腕のいいトレーナーだったなんて、知らなかったわ。

key: Would it be okay if Snubbull went with you?
en: Would it be okay if Snubbull went with you?
ja: ブルーを一緒に連れて行ってもらえないかしら?

key: Honestly, if it won't listen, I'm clearly not cut out to be a Trainer, so...
en: Honestly, if it won't listen, I'm clearly not cut out to be a Trainer, so...
ja: 正直、言うこと聞いてくれないなら、わたしはトレーナーに向いてないってことだから……

key: I'm obviously not qualified to take care of it.
en: I'm obviously not qualified to take care of it.
ja: 明らかに、この子の世話をする資格がわたしにはないの。

key: Would you take it?
en: Would you take it?
ja: 引き取ってくれる?

key: Oh... Thank you. I hope you can take better care of it than I have.
en: Oh... Thank you. I hope you can take better care of it than I have.
ja: あら……ありがとう。わたしより上手に世話してあげてね。

key: Ah... No, you're right, I need to work harder.
en: Ah... No, you're right, I need to work harder.
ja: ああ……いいえ、そうよね、わたしがもっと頑張らなきゃ。

key: Would it be okay if Stufful went with you?
en: Would it be okay if Stufful went with you?
ja: ヌイコグマを一緒に連れて行ってもらえないかしら?

key: Hey! How is Snubbull doing?
en: Hey! How is Snubbull doing?
ja: ねえ! ブルーは元気にしてる?

key: Hey! How is Stufful doing?
en: Hey! How is Stufful doing?
ja: ねえ! ヌイコグマは元気にしてる?

key: Hey! Have you been taking good care of Snubbull?
en: Hey! Have you been taking good care of Snubbull?
ja: ねえ! ブルーのことちゃんと大事にしてくれてる?

key: Wait, you have HOW many Badges now?!
en: Wait, you have HOW many Badges now?!
ja: ちょっと、バッジ今何個持ってるの!?

key: I remember when you first got your Pokémon and were new to this city. Now look at you!
en: I remember when you first got your Pokémon and were new to this city. Now look at you!
ja: 最初にポケモンをもらって、この街に来たばかりだった頃を覚えてるわ。今じゃこんなに!

key: Shoot, I sound like a grandma!
en: Shoot, I sound like a grandma!
ja: やだ、おばあちゃんみたいなこと言ってる!

key: Hey! Have you been taking good care of Stufful?
en: Hey! Have you been taking good care of Stufful?
ja: ねえ! ヌイコグマのことちゃんと大事にしてくれてる?

key: Are your Pokémon getting too high leveled?
en: Are your Pokémon getting too high leveled?
ja: ポケモンのレベルが上がりすぎちゃった?

key: Keep them under control by raising full teams or using Common Candies.
en: Keep them under control by raising full teams or using Common Candies.
ja: フルパーティで育てるか、ノーマルアメを使って調整するといいわよ。

key: I tried to tell that to my sister, but she insists candy is bad for Pokémon. Everything has its uses!
en: I tried to tell that to my sister, but she insists candy is bad for Pokémon. Everything has its uses!
ja: 妹にも教えようとしたんだけど、アメはポケモンに悪いって言い張るのよね。何にでも使い道があるのに!

key: Well, she doesn't seem to want this. Do you?
en: Well, she doesn't seem to want this. Do you?
ja: まあ、妹はこれ欲しくないみたいだから。あなたはどう?

key: Thanks so much for taking care of my sister's Pokémon, by the way.
en: Thanks so much for taking care of my sister's Pokémon, by the way.
ja: それはそうと、妹のポケモンの世話をしてくれて本当にありがとう。

key: I wish she'd just listen to me, but it is how it is.
en: I wish she'd just listen to me, but it is how it is.
ja: わたしの言うことを聞いてくれたらいいんだけど、まあ仕方ないわね。

key: If only people like her could tell someone "exppercent"... then, maybe, they could have exact control over how much their Pokémon grow.
en: If only people like her could tell someone "exppercent"... then, maybe, they could have exact control over how much their Pokémon grow.
ja: ああいう人が誰かに「exppercent」って言えたらいいのに……そうすれば、ポケモンの成長量を正確にコントロールできるかもしれないのに。

key: My sister could make hers grow slower, or not at all...
en: My sister could make hers grow slower, or not at all...
ja: 妹なら、成長を遅くしたり、全く成長させないようにしたりできるかも……

key: Or, someone else could make theirs grow faster!
en: Or, someone else could make theirs grow faster!
ja: あるいは、誰かは逆に成長を速くできるかもね!

key: Or, people could even make their Pokémon grow backwards!
en: Or, people could even make their Pokémon grow backwards!
ja: それか、ポケモンを逆に成長させることだってできちゃうかも!

key: ...Actually, why would anyone ever want that?
en: ...Actually, why would anyone ever want that?
ja: ……というか、そんなの誰が望むのかしら?

key: Who am I kidding, there's no way it'd be that simple.
en: Who am I kidding, there's no way it'd be that simple.
ja: 何言ってるんだろう、そんな簡単なわけないのに。

key: Shnub.
en: Shnub.
ja: ブルー。

key: Lull~
en: Lull~
ja: ヌイ~

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
